Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Deepak Sibal
Present: Mr.Rajbir Singh, Advocate, for the petitioner.

Through the present petition filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. the petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No.177 dated 10.08.2022 registered under Section 420 IPC at Police Station Bhawanigarh,
District Sangrur.

On 12.09.2022 this Court had passed the following order: -
"Notice of motion was issued by this Court on 31.08.2022 and the State was directed to file an affidavit before the next date of hearing.
However, learned State counsel has stated that some more time may be granted to the State to file an affidavit.

The present is the case pertaining to the prayer for granting anticipatory bail.
Today, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that even otherwise the matter has been settled between the parties.

sentences.text: In view of the above, it is directed that the petitioner shall join investigation and the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be released on interim bail subject to furnishing personal bond/surety bond to the satisfaction of Arresting/Investigating Officer.
The petitioner shall abide by all the conditions as provided under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C."

Learned State counsel submits that in pursuance to the afore quoted order the petitioner has joined and cooperated with the investigation; the State no longer requires the petitioner for investigation purposes as also that the dispute which is the subject matter of the present FIR has been settled between the petitioner and the complainant.

1 of 2  Neutral Citation No:=2023:P CRM-M-39085-2022 [2]
In the light of the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner as have been recorded in the afore quoted order as also the statement made on behalf of the State, subject to the petitioner's abiding by the conditions prescribed under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C the order of this Court dated 12.09.2022,
granting ad interim anticipatory bail to the petitioner is ordered to be made absolute.
